answer: Rewards flow only to agents whose bonded identity is pinned to one graph vertex; a rotating random haven holds the escrow until a fresh liveness proof clears. A Sybil farmer must lock a full bond for every fake vertex, so the bill grows linearly while payout per identity is capped. Slashing burns all bonds behind a caught clone, making the farm negative-return; a single honest jade deposit survives the audit and is returned with interest.
